```{r}
#| label: plot-top10-highlights
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# Define the 3 notable songs from the previous exercise
notable_songs <- c("Song A", "Song B", "Song C")

# Filter dataset for songs that reached the top 10
top_10_data <- chart_data %>%
  filter(peak_rank <= 10)

# Create the plot
ggplot(top_10_data, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = song_id)) +
  # Background layer: All top-10 songs in gray
  geom_line(color = "gray80", alpha = 0.6) +
  # Foreground layer: Highlight notable songs with color mapping for legend
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_data, song_name %in% notable_songs),
    aes(color = song_name),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Chart Position",
    color = "Notable Songs",
    title = "Top 10 Songs Chart Trajectories"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
